title: Federal cyber experts called Microsoft's cloud a "pile of shit," approved it anyway - Ars Technica
summary: Federal cyber experts criticized Microsoft's cloud security as inadequate, despite claims to the contrary. The Justice Department's reliance on cloud companies' assessments and third-party firms has raised concerns about the thoroughness of security reviews. Microsoft was also found to have used China-based engineers for servicing sensitive systems, a practice that was against the Justice Department's policy and was discovered through a ProPublica investigation.
sentiment_reason: The article presents negative sentiment due to security concerns and potential misrepresentations by cloud companies, which align with recession fears and earnings misses in the market.
